Package com.codedstream.otterstream.runtime.spi

Interface ModelRegistry

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultModelRegistry
public interface ModelRegistry
Service Provider Interface (SPI) for resolving a ModelReference to a concrete, loadable ModelConfig.

This is the extension point for integrating Otter with external model stores such as MLflow, S3, MinIO, Azure Blob, GCS, or a Nexus repository: implement this interface against the store's API and hand resolved ModelConfigs back to the runtime. Otter ships a simple in-memory default (DefaultModelRegistry) suitable for statically-configured deployments; production use cases that need registry polling / auto-discovery of new versions build on top of this SPI.

Scope note: Otter deliberately stops at "resolve a reference to a model config." Training, hyperparameter tuning, feature engineering, experiment tracking, drift detection, and retraining orchestration are explicitly out of scope and remain the responsibility of the MLOps platform (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, etc.) that backs the registry.

Since:
0.1.0

    • register

      default void register(String modelId, ModelConfig config)
      Registers/updates a model configuration under a given logical model id.

      Optional operation; registries backed by a read-only external store (e.g. a pre-populated S3 bucket) may not support programmatic registration.

      Parameters:
      modelId - logical model identifier
      config - the configuration to register
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if this registry is read-only
